author: CrashCourse
description:
Are we in a new geological epoch? Some geologists think so–one marked by human impact on Earth. Others say we’re not there yet. Either way, what is clear is that humans have had a big impact on Earth—sometimes in irreversible ways. In this episode, we’ll learn about the Anthropocene and how humans can reverse or adapt to the changes we’ve caused on Earth. 

Introduction: Plastic Rocks 00:00
Human impact on Earth 0:47
Is it the Anthropocene yet? 2:15
Can we reverse or adapt to these changes? 5:21
Review and Credits 10:10
